_comment: Project settings for the post-merge QA agent. Everything project-specific lives here so the script itself stays generic. See qa-agent/README.md.
project_description: .NET / Aspire reference e-commerce application: Blazor storefront (WebApp, WebAppComponents) backed by microservices (Catalog.API, Basket.API (gRPC + Redis), Ordering.API, Identity.API (login), Webhooks.API, OrderProcessor, PaymentProcessor) communicating over RabbitMQ integration events.
suite_description: Playwright end-to-end tests (e2e/*.spec.ts) that drive the storefront in a browser, either anonymously or logged in as the seeded user.

test_data.title: Seeded product catalog
test_data.note: the ONLY products that exist; names and prices are exact

prompt_vars.example_step: Add 'Adventurer GPS Watch' to the bag
prompt_vars.helpers_rules: reuse the existing helpers from '../cart-helpers' (addProductToCart, emptyCart, removeFirstCartItem) instead of re-implementing them. Imports are relative to e2e/generated/.
prompt_vars.auth_rules: Authentication is handled by the Playwright project (storage state) - never log in inside the test. Specs run serially and share the seeded user's basket: every test that touches the cart must start from emptyCart(page) and leave the cart empty.
